title: harnesses.toml
description:
The Harnesses this machine can start, in this order.
Without the file, Banda starts Claude Code and Codex, each with the
Person's own CLI.

limits.description:
How Banda reads the usage limits of each Harness's account (ADR
0043).

usage.description: Whether local session journals are counted (ADR 0043).

HarnessEntry.description:
One `[[harness]]` table. An entry with the ID of a Harness Banda
knows, `claude` or `codex`, takes each key it leaves out from Banda:
so a Banda that moves an adapter to a newer version moves this
machine's too. Any other ID needs a `name` and a `command`.

short.description: What a sentence calls it, when shorter than its name: `Claude`.

command.description: The program that speaks ACP: its name on PATH, or its path.

enabled.description:
Whether it is on. One turned off stays in the list, with how it
starts, for when it is turned on again.

env.description: Variables over the environment it starts in.

cli.description: The Person's own CLI the program runs, when it runs one.

of.description:
The Harness this entry is an account of, by its ID: `claude`,
`codex`, or an entry above it. An account takes that Harness's
program, adapter and CLI, and adds its own name and variables, such
as its `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` or `CODEX_HOME` (ADR 0078, decision 1).

mark.description:
The letters of its mark, one or two: by default the first of its
name, two when another account of its Harness starts the same. The
emblem of a Harness Banda has no icons for shows them.

icon.description:
The icon of its emblem (ADR 0093, decision 2): `claude-code` or
`claude` for Claude Code's accounts, `codex` or `chatgpt` for
Codex's, or for any account `work`, `personal`, `team`, `client`,
`spare`, `experiments`, `key`, `gateway`, `cloud`, `local` or `box`.
By default its kind's: its Harness's program's for a subscription,
`key` for an API key, `gateway` for a gateway.

colour.description:
Its colour: 0 its Harness's own (Claude's orange, Codex's the
text's), 1 violet, 2 rose, 3 green, 4 graphite. By default a
Harness's own entry takes its own, and its accounts 1 to 4 in turn.

Cli.description:
A CLI the Person installed, which an adapter runs in place of a copy
of its own (ADR 0003, decision 3).

program.description: Its name on PATH, or its path.

variable.description:
The variable that tells the adapter where it is: Claude Code's
`CLAUDE_CODE_EXECUTABLE`, Codex's `CODEX_PATH`.

minimum.description:
The oldest version the adapter supports: the one it was built for.
An older CLI still runs, with a warning.

oneOf.description: A plan, signed in through the Harness's own sign-in.

Billed by the token, signed in through the Harness's own API
sign-in, such as Anthropic Console or `codex login --with-api-key`.
A gateway's base URL and key, such as OpenRouter's.

Icon.description:
The icon of an account's emblem (ADR 0093, decision 2): two of its
Harness's own for Claude Code and Codex, and the neutral ones any
account may take.

oneOf.description: Claude Code's character, from the block characters its CLI prints.
Claude's spark.
Codex's mark: a filled shape with `>_` cut out.
OpenAI's knot.
A briefcase: the work account.
A house: one's own.
People: a team's plan.
A building: a client's or an employer's.
A life buoy: kept for when the others are out.
A flask: trying models and settings.
A key: an API key, billed by use.
Two paths joining: a gateway, such as OpenRouter or LiteLLM.
A cloud: Bedrock, Vertex.
A chip: a local model, such as Ollama or LM Studio.
A box: an environment sign-in (ADR 0084).

LimitsEntry.description: The `[limits]` table. Every key is optional.

read.description:
Whether Banda reads them: off, it reads no Harness's sign-in and
asks for no limits.

every.description:
How often it reads them while a window is open, such as `"15m"` or
`"1h"`: 5 minutes or more.

warn.description: The share spent, out of 100, from which the bar's widget warns.

look.description: How the bar's widget shows the room left.

LimitsLook.description:
How the bar's widget shows the room left: `[limits] look` (ADR 0055,
decision 2).

oneOf.description: A gauge.
A thin bar and the share.
The share alone.
Each Harness's share: `Claude 74% · Codex 12%`.

UsageSettings.description: Local journal collection. Turning it off preserves saved totals but reads no files.

read.description: Read Claude Code and Codex session journals on this computer.

OmarchySettings.description: Automatic discovery on Omarchy. Explicit Harness entries take priority.

enabled.description: Discover installed ACP Harnesses and Accounts from Omarchy's registry.

excluded.description: Discovered entries removed in Banda. Explicit entries still win.
